hook: Gemini may send excerpts of your Drive files to human reviewers.
what_happened: Google's help page says some Connected Apps data, including Drive and Gmail excerpts, is human-reviewed. One tester says Gemini fetches it without @ tags.
why_it_matters: In 2023 Google said Bard's Workspace content was not seen by human reviewers. Its blog now says human review can happen in limited circumstances.
what_to_do: Avoid connecting your apps to Gemini Apps if they contain confidential information you wouldn't want a reviewer to see.
the_catch: Personal accounts only; the author says Workspace business and education accounts are excluded. Retrieval is also probabilistic.
caption: Google Gemini may send excerpts of personal Drive files and Gmail messages to human reviewers. Private or exposed?
alt_text: The slides explain that Google Gemini may retrieve personal Drive and Gmail data and send it to human reviewers, note the probabilistic nature, and advise not connecting confidential apps.

es.hook: Gemini puede enviar fragmentos de tus archivos de Drive a revisores humanos.
es.what_happened: La página de ayuda de Google dice que algunos datos de Connected Apps, incluidos fragmentos de Drive y Gmail, son revisados por humanos. Un probador afirma que Gemini los extrae sin etiquetas @.
es.why_it_matters: En 2023 Google afirmó que el contenido de Workspace de Bard no era revisado por revisores humanos. Ahora su blog indica que la revisión humana puede ocurrir en circunstancias limitadas.
es.what_to_do: Evita conectar tus aplicaciones a Gemini Apps si contienen información confidencial que no querrías que un revisor vea.
es.the_catch: Solo cuentas personales; el autor indica que las cuentas de Workspace para empresas y educación están excluidas. Además, la recuperación es probabilística.
